Lyricify.Lyrics.Helper
Copied from G:\SoftwareProject\winui\music_player\External\Lyricify.Lyrics.Helper.
The local System.Text.Json / source-generated variant is retained.
Upstream: https://github.com/WXRIW/Lyricify-Lyrics-Helper
License: Apache-2.0; full license in Lyricify.Lyrics.Helper/LICENSE.
Integration change: portable net10.0 target, without Windows-only RIDs.

Qwen3-ASR and Qwen3-ForcedAligner
Upstream: https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR (Apache-2.0).
Models download separately with pinned revisions and SHA-256 manifests.
ONNX exports: andrewleech/qwen3-asr-1.7b-onnx and
jinhwan000/qwen3-aligner-0.6b-onnx on Hugging Face (Apache-2.0).
TimestampRepair follows the upstream forced-aligner monotonic subsequence algorithm.
Japanese alignment uses TinySegmenter instead of the upstream Python nagisa dependency.

TinySegmenter 0.2
Copyright (c) 2008, Taku Kudo <taku@chasen.org>
Source mirror: https://github.com/leungwensen/tiny-segmenter/blob/master/lib/index.js
C# adaptation and data extraction: JapaneseSegmenter.cs, tinysegmenter.json.
